items.title: Ken Peplowski interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: But as Dizzy Gillespie said one time, you’re only a half step away from salvation at any given moment.

ctx.x: And how do I get out of something that I didn’t mean to play? Did that ever happen to you?

Yeah. Oh, of course. In fact sometimes you can do that. You play little tricks on yourself. You paint yourself into a corner and then you try to get out of it. But as Dizzy Gillespie said one time, you’re only a half step away from salvation at any given moment. Because when you look at a chord and you look at extensions of the chord, you keep adding thirds onto the chord, you have every note in the chromatic scale anyway. So it’s all how it comes out at the end, how you resolve a phrase. So to me the object is…
Well I was going to give you a little blindfold test here, did you ever do one of those?
